key_exclusions: competitor must be an authorized dealer
policy_text_full: Crutchfield offers a 60-day price guarantee — among the longest in retail. If a price drops at Crutchfield or an authorized competitor dealer within 60 days of purchase, Crutchfield refunds the difference to original tender. Competitor matches are limited to authorized dealers; clearance and scratch-and-dent items are excluded.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 60 days of purchase, customers can claim a price adjustment if Crutchfield or an authorized-dealer competitor lowers the price.
